data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Migrate all pre-existing curl-counting and curl-body-capture assertions. All existing tests that count curl invocations (e.g., _CURL_CALL_COUNT) or capture curl request bodies must be rewritten to count llm-api-call.sh invocations and capture its arguments instead. Use a shared counter file passed to _create_mock_llm_api_call() to count calls; the mock appends a line per invocation. Tests that assert request JSON structure (model ID, messages array) should be dropped or reframed to assert llm-api-call.sh argument positions (arg[1]=agent-file, arg[2]=user-message, arg[3]=tier).
